subject: english-literature
title: Five Steps Up the Pyramid
welcome_lead: Most stories climb a pyramid and then descend. Let's map the steps.
meta_desc: KS3 English Literature adventure on the five-stage plot structure.
final_note: You can now identify exposition through resolution.

concepts.def: Opening that sets up world and people.
Events that build tension toward climax.
Peak turning point of the story.
The ending that ties off the conflict.
Diagram of the five plot stages.

walkthroughs.body_html: Most stories follow exposition → rising action → climax → falling action → resolution. This is the backbone of plot.
The climax is the highest tension — the moment that decides the outcome. Everything before builds toward it; everything after falls from it.
Gustav Freytag drew the five-stage plot as a pyramid. Use it to plan or analyse stories at a glance.

mcqs.q: What is the function of dystopian fiction?
options: Dystopian fiction predicts what will actually happen in 100 years.
Dystopian fiction is just storytelling set in scary futures.
It means it is wrong to write fiction.
To critique tendencies in the writer's own society by extrapolating them into a nightmarish future — dystopias hold up a warning mirror to the present.
Any novel with a young protagonist is a bildungsroman.
Dystopian fiction predicts what will actually happen in 100 years.
A novel tracing a protagonist's moral and psychological development from youth to adulthood — typically involving formative experiences and a clearer sense of self.
A bildungsroman is a novel about constructing buildings.
The claim that judging a text by what the author 'intended' is fallacious — the text's meaning lies in the work itself, not the author's stated or guessed intentions.
Dystopian fiction predicts what will actually happen in 100 years.
It means it is wrong to write fiction.
It means authors can never make mistakes when writing.
